mapper.select: /* give-point-expiration-mapper.getGivePointExpirationMailInfoList (포인트 만료 메일 정보 목록) */ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.POINT, A.POINT_END_DE, crypto_dec('normal', A.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME, crypto_dec('normal', A.EMAIL, '', 0) AS EMAIL, crypto_dec('normal', A.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID, A.STATUS_CODE FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID, A.POINT, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(A.POINT_END_DE, INTERVAL -1 DAY), '%Y년%m월%d일') AS POINT_END_DE, CASE WHEN U.STATUS_CODE = 9 THEN U.USER_NAME ELSE S.USER_NAME END AS USER_NAME, CASE WHEN U.STATUS_CODE = 9 THEN U.EMAIL ELSE S.EMAIL END AS EMAIL, U.LOGIN_ID, U.STATUS_CODE FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, POINT_END_DE, SUM(CNTR_BLCE_POINT) AS POINT FROM G_CNTR WHERE IFNULL(CNTR_BLCE_POINT, 0) > 0 AND IFNULL(POINT_END_DE, '') != '' AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(POINT_END_DE, INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' GROUP BY USER_ID, POINT_END_DE ) A INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE IN (4, 9) LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER_SLEEP S ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID ) A
/* give-point-expiration-mapper.getShopName (상점명 조회) */ SELECT SHOP_NAME FROM OP_CONFIG WHERE SHOP_CONFIG_ID = #{shopConfigId}
